function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "The red block remains on the table at roughly x=-0.07, y=0.10; the gripper closed empty about 1.3cm short of it. Cartesian move_to calls were throttled to 1-3 control steps (about 0.5-1.5cm of travel) per policy call throughout the trial, so after locating and approaching the block there are too few calls left to reopen, regrasp, lift, carry about 17cm to the bowl, and release. Task not completed.", "hindsight": "move_to Cartesian moves executed only 1-3 control steps per policy call in this trial while gripper open/close ran its full ~80-step cycle; plan for centimeter-scale progress per call and command final targets, not waypoints. The wrist camera tilts with arm posture, so fingertip-relative pixel offsets drift; using a known object width as pixel scale and cross-checking the fixed side view (image right is -y, front view image right is -x) is more reliable. Table at z=0.80, a ~4cm block top is near z=0.845, and a fully closed empty gripper reads about 0.02 versus about 0.34 when holding this block."}
